描述_ZN: Zhang Ji (1882-1947), whose family name was Puquan, was born in Cang County, Hebei Province. He was born in Cang County, Hebei Province. He studied in Japan and at Waseda University, and later often traveled to Europe. He edited "Minpo" in Japan and published "New Century" in Paris, and the Revolution became the center of journalism. After the Xinhai Revolution (1911), he founded the Kuomintang with his comrades and became a member of the Central Executive Committee. He also served as a member of the Kuomintang Committee and as director of the Museum of Documents of the National Palace Museum in Beiping.
